quotes.text: Save Australia BECS Direct Debit details for future payments
Use the Setup Intents API to save payment method details for future Australia BECS Direct Debit payments.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: A [SetupIntent](https://docs.stripe.com/api/setup_intents.md) is an object that represents your intent to set up a customer’s payment method for future payments.
A successful setup returns a `succeeded` value for the SetupIntent’s `status` property.
When the SetupIntent succeeds, it will create a new *PaymentMethod*
The PaymentIntent created with the resulting PaymentMethod transitions from `processing` to `succeeded`.

findings: The November 7 raw is an 18-line index. It establishes the Setup Intents API purpose and five variant links: Elements, Direct API, iOS, Android and React Native (new raw lines 5-18). It does not include specific consent terms, API requests, SDK calls, eligibility, state transitions or outcomes. The diff replaces the prior detailed body with variant navigation (diff lines 3-13, 1765-1771), which does not prove a product change or deprecation.

The May 2 old capture contains substantive Elements, iOS, Android and React Native setup paths (old raw lines 8-12, 757-765, 1110-1118, 1463-1471). The November Direct API route is a new navigation label relative to the old composite capture (new raw line 14); its target was not pinned or read, so no Direct API behavior can be inferred from that link.

The existing summary omits the old React Native branch and the new Direct API route (source lines 13, 54-56; old raw lines 1463-1471, 1589-1593, 1618-1624, 1698-1716; new raw lines 13-18). Both are central route-selection topics, so the corrected source should distinguish old detailed coverage from new uninspected navigation. The Stripe provider index line 258 and concept source label line 101 also omit React Native; the concept route itself exists.

Baseline source error: its iOS section says 'Same STPAUBECSFormView + STPPaymentHandler as accept-a-payment flow, but using SetupIntent client secret' (source lines 35-38). The old setup branch uses STPSetupIntentConfirmParams and STPPaymentHandler.confirmSetupIntent, not a PaymentIntent confirmation call (old raw lines 1022-1037, 1048-1073). Also the old prose names STPAUBECSFormView but its Swift class/delegate code uses STPAUBECSDebitFormView (old raw lines 904-906, 916, 958-960); this internal name mismatch needs a qualification, not a guessed canonical symbol.

The old Elements consent path requires account holder name, BSB and account number, service agreement presentation, accepted DDR shareability and merchant-adjusted authorization wording (old raw lines 161-181, 347-367). React Elements additionally says billing_details name and email are required for BECS PaymentMethod creation (old raw lines 513-517). The existing source lines 17-19 compress these requirements without the ongoing shareability obligation and line 27 frames all post-setup message elements as if required, whereas the old capture recommends business name/amount/schedule and DDR link after successful confirmation (old raw lines 494-501).

Setup success is separate from payment success: the old guide says confirmation can yield SetupIntent succeeded and attach a PaymentMethod to the specified Customer, then a later PaymentIntent is created to charge it (old raw lines 469-471, 719-754). Its test table explicitly describes PaymentIntent behavior created with the resulting PaymentMethod (old raw lines 671-686), including processing before succeeded, failures, mandate status and disputes. Current source lines 40-52 present a future PaymentIntent example but do not make the separate lifecycle boundary explicit.

Android old prose and code are internally inconsistent: the Activity declares setupIntentClientSecret but passes paymentIntentClientSecret on button click (old raw lines 1298-1325); the later handler uses ConfirmSetupIntentParams and PaymentLauncher.confirm (old raw lines 1386-1417), while testing names Stripe#confirmSetupIntent (old raw line 1448). Treat these as dated examples with a warning, not guaranteed executable instructions.
substantive_changes: No substantive integration change is established in the November index (new raw lines 9-18). The source update is needed for dated navigation/provenance plus pre-existing iOS wording and SetupIntent-versus-future-PaymentIntent qualification (source lines 13, 35-52; old raw lines 1022-1037, 719-754).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain the May 2 capture as dated detailed authority for SetupIntent server creation with au_becs_debit and customer_account or customer, client secret handling, client DDR/bank detail collection, setup confirmation, then reusable PaymentMethod/Mandate (old raw lines 31-43, 77-131, 161-181, 461-501, 719-754). Accounts v2 availability was GA for Connect users and preview for others in that capture, not verified current access (old raw lines 35-43).

Retain branch-specific old details: Elements HTML/React AuBankAccountElement and required billing name/email (old raw lines 183-185, 282-287, 369-371, 513-517); iOS SetupIntent confirm via STPSetupIntentConfirmParams/STPPaymentHandler.confirmSetupIntent (old raw lines 1022-1058); Android BecsDebitWidget and ConfirmSetupIntentParams/PaymentLauncher example with its variable inconsistency (old raw lines 1230-1236, 1298-1325, 1386-1417); React Native AuBECSDebitForm/useConfirmSetupIntent (old raw lines 1589-1593, 1698-1716).

Retain ongoing DDR/service-agreement shareability and the difference between required authorization/consent and recommended post-confirmation communication (old raw lines 173-181, 494-501); the old code's copied sample text is not a separately validated legal template.

Retain test-account table as tests of later PaymentIntents using the saved PaymentMethod, including processing-to-succeeded, processing-to-requires_payment_method, mandate active/inactive and dispute outcomes (old raw lines 671-686, 1093-1108, 1446-1461, 1745-1760), never as proof that a SetupIntent confirmation charges or settles funds.
conflicts: Source line 37 says the iOS setup uses the same STPPaymentHandler flow as accept-a-payment except client secret; old setup prose and code explicitly call confirmSetupIntent with STPSetupIntentConfirmParams (old raw lines 1022-1037, 1054-1058). The source should distinguish SetupIntent from PaymentIntent confirmation.

Old iOS prose names STPAUBECSFormView while old Swift code names STPAUBECSDebitFormView (old raw lines 904-906, 916, 958-960); source lines 13, 35-37 assert the prose name without warning. Old Android Activity refers to paymentIntentClientSecret while declaring/setup-intending setupIntentClientSecret (old raw lines 1298-1325), and old Android prose/code/test use differing confirm references (old raw lines 1399-1417, 1448).

Source line 13 describes off-session charging, but the old 'Accepting future payments' section describes a subsequent server PaymentIntent with confirm:true and does not itself use an off_session parameter (old raw lines 719-754). Preserve future-payment reuse without asserting an account's actual off-session capability or settled result.
unresolved_questions: The November Direct API and other variant targets were navigation only in this pin and were not read; their current API shape, terms, and SDK instructions cannot be established (new raw lines 11-18).

The old iOS class spelling and Android sample variable/call discrepancies need separately pinned SDK or variant evidence before recommending exact executable mobile code (old raw lines 904-906, 916, 1298-1325, 1399-1417, 1448).

findings: Add the new index as a distinct November raw reference/navigation source, retain the May full raw and date its detailed authority (new raw lines 5-18; source lines 4-7, 54-56; old raw lines 1-12).
Expose React Native detailed old route and the new Direct API link as navigation only (old raw lines 1463-1471, 1698-1716; new raw lines 13-18; source lines 11-13).
Correct iOS setup confirmation identity and qualify old iOS/Android sample symbol inconsistencies (source lines 35-38; old raw lines 904-916, 1022-1058, 1298-1325, 1399-1417).

State that SetupIntent succeeded attaches a saved method/mandate and does not itself establish a later PaymentIntent's success, funds availability or mandate durability (old raw lines 469-471, 719-754, 671-686; source lines 40-52).
conflicts: Source line 37 blurs setup versus payment confirmation; old iOS prose/code and Android examples have internal symbol/variable conflicts at old raw lines 904-916, 1022-1058, 1298-1325, 1399-1417, 1448.
source_assessments.reason: The new capture is only variant navigation, but the mapped source has a material pre-existing iOS identity error, omits the React Native route and the newly listed Direct API route, and should make the SetupIntent-versus-future-PaymentIntent outcome boundary explicit.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/au-becs-debit/set-up-payment, the complete November capture establishes a Setup Intents API purpose and links to Elements, Direct API, iOS, Android and React Native variants, but no detailed prerequisite or outcome rules (new raw lines 5-18). The May 2 capture documents server SetupIntent creation for au_becs_debit linked to a customer-configured Account v2 or Customer v1, client DDR consent and bank details, SetupIntent confirmation, and a resulting reusable PaymentMethod/Mandate; only a separate later PaymentIntent can attempt a debit (old raw lines 31-43, 77-131, 161-181, 469-501, 719-754). source-stripe-au-becs-set-up-payment.md covers Elements and mobile setup but omits React Native, misstates iOS confirmation as essentially the accept-payment handler flow, and should distinguish SetupIntent succeeded from later PaymentIntent processing/success or failure (source lines 13-52; old raw lines 1022-1058, 671-686).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/payments/au-becs-debit/set-up-payment, the November difference is navigation and presentation: a short variant index replaces the old full body and newly lists Direct API, but supplies no Direct API semantics, deprecation, or refreshed integration behavior (new raw lines 9-18; diff lines 3-13, 1765-1771). In source-stripe-au-becs-set-up-payment.md, detailed Elements, DDR, mobile, Account/Customer and future PaymentIntent claims must remain attributed to the May 2 raw, including Accounts v2 preview availability, Stripe.js dahlia, and branch-specific iOS/Android SDK code (old raw lines 35-43, 145-181, 757-765, 1110-1118). Correct the iOS SetupIntent-versus-PaymentIntent wording, and warn that the old iOS prose/code names and Android sample variables/call references conflict (source lines 35-38; old raw lines 904-916, 1022-1058, 1298-1325, 1399-1417). A saved method, client return or SetupIntent success does not prove a later debit succeeded or funds settled; test outcomes concern later PaymentIntents (old raw lines 469-471, 671-686, 719-754).
